svg.title: Meridian Retail Group — Figure 1 — End-to-end data flow
svg.text: End-to-end data flow: twelve sources to every consumer
every source lands once · bronze → silver → gold per domain · streaming paths drawn apart from batch · every arrow carries the business latency requirement (§3.0, §5.2, §5.4, §5.6)
CONSUMERS · and the freshness they get
People · org and cost centre first
All domains · 20 years of business logic
conform · deduplicate · assign keys · enforce expectations
basket line — three POS schemas conformed to one
SCD2 · blocking gate on 3,100 unclassified SKUs
append-only + restatement flag — no in-place correction
What lands, and what it grows to
COPY INTO from a governed volume
Every source lands once. Nothing reads a source system except an ingestion pipeline; nothing writes to gold except a pipeline in version control (§5.1).
